en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਅਸਾਧ ਜਗਤ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh manmukh jaaneean saadh asaadh jagat varataaraa|

en.bdb: From their conduct in the world, the Guru-oriented, gurmukhs and mind oriented manmukhs are known sadhus and wicked ones respectively.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਬਾਜਰੇ ਖਰਬੜ ਹੋਏ ਖੁਦੀ ਖੁਆਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuh vich dhukhee dhubaajare kharabaR hoe khudhee khuaaraa|

en.bdb: Out of these two, the mongrels-apparently sadhus but internally thieves--are always in wavering state and, suffering for their ego, go astray.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੀਂ ਸਰਾਈਂ ਜਰਦਰੂ ਦਗੇ ਦੁਰਾਹੇ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਗਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuhee(n) saraiee(n) jaradharoo dhage dhuraahe chor chugaaraa|

en.bdb: Such double-faced thieves, backbiters and cheats remain pale-faced due to their bewilderment in both the worlds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: naa uravaar na paar hai gote khaan bharam sir bhaaraa|

en.bdb: They are neither here nor there and, burdened with the load of delusions go on drowing in between and getting suffocated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: hi(n)dhoo musalamaan vich gurmukh manmukh vich gubaaraa|

en.bdb: Whether Muslim or the Hindu, the manmukh among the gurmukhs is the utter darkness.
His head is always loaded with the comings and goings through transmigration of his soul.
